Credit terms: which term a changed invoice date uses

An invoice was created when the customer was on Net 30. Later the customer is moved to Net 60, and then someone changes that invoice's date. Is the new due date counted with Net 30 (the invoice's own term) or Net 60 (the customer's term now)?
(a) Net 30, the term the invoice was created with (the invoice keeps its term)

Credit terms: the words in the Due on Receipt info tooltip

On the Credit Terms page, Due on Receipt has an info (i) icon. Hovering it shows a sentence. The design and the spec use different words for the second half of that sentence. Which words should the tooltip show?
(a) As the spec: "Payment is due on the invoice date. You can charge the invoice to the customer's account instead of taking payment."
(b) As the design: "Payment is due on the invoice date, but you can create the invoice without taking payment."
(c) Something else (please give the exact words).

The spec gives the first wording for this tooltip (and in its summary table). The design draws the tooltip open with the second wording, and uses the same words on every page of the design. The COD and Credit Hold tooltips match the spec word for word.

Credit terms: when the "Enter a name." error first shows in the New Credit Term window

The user opens New Credit Term, clicks into the Name box, types nothing, and clicks somewhere else in the window. Should the error "Enter a name." show?
(a) No, as the spec: the name is checked only once the user has typed in it (then each time they leave it) or presses Create.
(b) Yes, as the design note can be read: "Errors show only after a field is touched or Create is pressed" (clicking in and out counts as touching).
